sn35.124:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
sn35.124:1.2: atha kho uggo gahapati vesāliko yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho uggo gahapati vesāliko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn35.124:1.3: ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yena midhekacce sattā diṭṭheva dhamme no parinibbāyanti.
sn35.124:1.4: ko pana bhante hetu ko paccayo yena midhekacce sattā diṭṭhe va dhamme parinibbāyantīti.
sn35.124:2.1: santi kho gahapati cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā
sn35.124:2.2: tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati tassa taṃ abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato taṃ nissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ hoti tadupādānaṃ.
sn35.124:2.5: santi kho gahapati manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā
sn35.124:2.6: tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati tassa taṃ abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato taṃ nissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ hoti tadupādānaṃ.
sn35.124:2.8: ayaṃ kho gahapati hetu ayaṃ paccayo yena midhekacce sattā diṭṭhe va dhamme no parinibbāyanti.
sn35.124:3.1: santi ca kho gahapati cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā
sn35.124:3.2: tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivadati na ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati tassa taṃ anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato na taṃ nissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ hoti na tadupādānaṃ.
sn35.124:3.5: santi kho gahapati manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā
sn35.124:3.6: tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivadati na ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati tassa taṃ anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato na taṃ nissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ hoti na tadupādānaṃ.
sn35.124:3.8: ayaṃ kho gahapati hetu ayaṃ paccayo yena midhekacce sattā diṭṭhe va dhamme parinibbāyantīti.
